title: Mutation begin-write operation

scope.rationale: The mutation compiler now has the source operation that verifies a schema, marks its write mask, and records multi-write statement requirements.

dependencies.caller_closure: The complete write-mask and statement-journal shaping body is translated.

inputs: Mutation Parse, statement-savepoint flag, database index
outputs: Schema verified, database bit added to write set, multi-write sticky flag updated
contracts.state_and_results: Existing multi-write state is never cleared.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No direct I/O; emits compiler state for later VDBE transaction setup.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Invalid database index or verification OOM propagates before write-mask mutation.

representation_differences: The bounded compiler uses a u64 schema mask and typed boolean multi-write state.

oracle.protocol: Begin writes on main and attached schemas with false/true statement flags.

assurance.oom: Verification append failure is bounded as NoMemory.
assurance.continuation: Prior mask and multi-write state remain sticky.
assurance.performance: Constant-time bit operations plus one-time schema verification.

known_blockers: Wire all mutation compiler callers and focused operation trace.

implementation_spans: top-level schema verification and Parse state
upstream_tests: Project mutation and broad runtime tests
